# Monthly rollup report command

Adds `pocket-ledger report --month YYYY-MM`, which aggregates the stored entries
into a per-category rollup and prints a right-aligned table to the terminal. Reads
through `ledger.store`; it never opens the database file directly.

## Behaviour

1. Resolve the requested month to a `[start, end)` UTC range.
2. Stream entries via `LedgerStore.iter_range` and bucket them by category.
3. Print a totals table, then the net change for the month.

## Output shape

| Category   | Debits  | Credits | Net     |
| ---------- | ------- | ------- | ------- |
| Groceries  | -142.10 | 0.00    | -142.10 |
| Salary     | 0.00    | 3200.00 | 3200.00 |
| **Total**  | -142.10 | 3200.00 | 3057.90 |

## Example

```console
$ pocket-ledger report --month 2026-02
Pocket Ledger — February 2026
  Groceries   -142.10
  Salary      3200.00
  ----------  -------
  Net          3057.90
```

Rounding follows banker's rounding on the cents-to-decimal conversion[^round].

[^round]: Half-even rounding keeps monthly nets stable when the same report is
    regenerated, so snapshot tests do not flake on the last digit.
